description:
[Trading Data API] OHLCV candles (oldest-first) for crypto or stocks. Routes to Alpaca SIP / Alpaca-crypto / Coinbase.

**Example:** `/v1/ohlcv?symbol=NVDA&timeframe=1h&limit=100`

Use when you need historical candles to chart or compute indicators yourself. Not for only the latest price (use price) or a ready-made indicator (atr, fvg, liquidity_levels).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).
name: ohlcv
